content.comment_body: I hope I'm on the right platform to share this idea... Currently, there isn't a recent version for Mac; the available one hasn't received updates in two years. Since the new Macs and iPads use Apple silicon, I think it would be a good and achievable idea to offer a universal version that runs on both devices. Having [product_name] software available on iPad would be useful for debugging or servicing, and could also help engage younger users with the [product_name] ecosystem.

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. I'm pleased that you appreciate [product_name]. However, this isn't the right thread for your topic, as it is focusing on project presentations utilizing the cloud features of the latest [product_name] [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Participants noted the lack of an updated universal version of [product_name] software for MacOS, which restricts mobility and usage across devices such as iPad and Apple Silicon Macs. The concern centers on outdated availability, reduced convenience, and missed opportunities for educational and service applications. There's a clear need highlighted for cross-platform, regularly updated solutions to reach broader user groups.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a current, universally compatible version of [product_name] software for iPad and Apple Silicon Macs, supporting portability, enhanced usability, and broad application including educational use.
